description: A waterfall chart should explain the movement, not just the change. Simple Waterfall Pro builds multi-step waterfall and bridge charts in Power BI with pillars you define yourself, by measure or by category, rather than the single total the standard visual allows. It exists because of four things that go wrong with waterfall charts once a report meets a real audience. Three charts on one page, three different axis scales, nothing comparable. Category names cut off mid-word. Data labels that vanish when someone resizes the page. Drill that stops working the moment the report is opened on a phone. Who it is for: Finance analysts, BI developers and report authors building variance analysis, budget against actual, margin walks, headcount bridges and P&L reporting. It is built for the charts that get questioned in the room: board packs, client reporting, and anything that will be opened on a tablet on the way to the meeting. Key features: One scale across every chart: Pin the value axis to a minimum, a maximum, or just one of the two, so charts sitting side by side can actually be compared Labels that survive a resize: A data label that will not fit is moved inside the plot, then shortened, and only hidden as a last resort. It is refitted every time you scroll Category names you can read: Rotate them, or fold the hierarchy onto a single line, instead of losing them to a three-line…
